text:
anya: Quick design review — noticed two a11y/focus issues in request drilldown (stacktrace accordion + corr id copy). Screenshot attached. matt: Thanks, can you repro? anya: Yes. Steps: open request > expand "Stack trace" > press Tab to move through controls. Focus gets trapped on the small copy button and doesn't continue to the "Open in new" link. Also VoiceOver announces "Copy" twice when the accordion toggles open. devin: Hmm, likely focus management bug on accordion open/close. We set focus back to the header on close which might be firing at the wrong time. sarah: Also noticed the focus ring contrast is weak in dark theme :eyes: anya: Proposal: on open, programmatically move focus to the first focusable element inside the accordion (the copy request ID button). When using keyboard, tabbing should flow out to the next region after the stack block. On close, restore focus to the accordion header. For SR announce, use a polite aria-live pattern like "Stack trace expanded" and avoid redundant announcements. aria-bot: Accessibility recommendation: add role="region" and aria-labelledby on the expanded stack content; ensure aria-expanded toggles before content injection for correct SR behavior. devin: Example aria-live snippet I think will help: ```
Stack trace expanded
...frames...
``` matt: Small copy tweak: change button label from "Copy" to "Copy request ID" for clarity; keep the tooltip as just "Copy" to avoid visual clutter. sarah: +1 on label. Also increase focus ring thickness to 3px and use var(--accent) for both themes. devin: Quick CSS patch that might help: ``` .stack-accordion:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } ``` anya: Can we add a keyboard shortcut (scoped) like Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C to copy the request ID when the accordion is open? Only enabled when no text input is focused. matt: Careful about shortcut conflicts, but scoped modifier combo sounds fine. Let's default to Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+C and gate it to the drilldown mount node. devin: I'll implement focus management + aria-live + shortcut, add unit+a11y tests, and run NVDA/VoiceOver checks. Will open a draft PR and ping for review. matt: Great — drop the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
